required_artifacts: official preliminary findings or AAR/IP excerpt with evaluated objectives, ORO scope, deficiency/ARCA/improvement-area status, ANS demonstration disposition
automatic_rejection: oral memory only; press summary only; no objective scope; no deficiency state; no custodian/hash
allowed_credit: candidate evidence for named exercise objectives only
forbidden_credit: whole exercise passed; BVPS ready; offsite readiness closed

required_artifacts: activation timestamps, channel, message content or reference, geography, delivery/failure/bounce state, evaluator disposition, backup alerting state
automatic_rejection: brochure/plan only; approval summary without logs; no failure state; no exercise window; route page only
allowed_credit: candidate evidence for specified alerting channel and time window
forbidden_credit: public alerting ready; ANS transition closed; all populations reached

required_artifacts: PEMA/FEMA approval/status letter, implementation date, interim credited system, affected counties, accessibility/backup controls, public notice artifacts
automatic_rejection: newsletter mention only; plan language without approval; undated status; no jurisdiction scope
allowed_credit: candidate evidence of approval/interim status only
forbidden_credit: transition adequate; old/new ANS fully credited; siren gate closed

required_artifacts: root cause/CAP, repair work order, restoral timestamp, post-maintenance/load/functional retest, compensatory-measure closeout, EOF availability declaration
automatic_rejection: Event Notification 58200 alone; no retest; no root cause; no compensatory-measure disposition
allowed_credit: candidate evidence of specific repair or retest element only
forbidden_credit: EOF recovery closed; emergency assessment capability fully proven

required_artifacts: LER accession or written no-LER/rationale, docket/release route, associated inspection/CAP references, dates
automatic_rejection: ADAMS route page only; search result only; no accession/rationale; outdated WBA link only
allowed_credit: candidate evidence of regulatory disposition route/status
forbidden_credit: EOF issue resolved; no safety consequence proven

required_artifacts: extent-of-play, objective matrix, facility availability, staffing/activation logs, evaluator notes, deficiency state
automatic_rejection: organization chart only; plan section only; no evaluated objective/time window
allowed_credit: candidate evidence for named facility/objective only

required_artifacts: AFN registry/card workflow, transportation provider roster, exercise inject/performance, accessibility failure/correction state
automatic_rejection: public brochure only; no exercise performance; no vulnerable-population scope
allowed_credit: candidate evidence for specified AFN/transport objective only
forbidden_credit: AFN readiness closed; access needs fully served

required_artifacts: production letter, redaction/exemption basis, file list, withheld-item description when available
automatic_rejection: unlinked upload; missing production context; no request id
allowed_credit: candidate context plus follow-up task trigger

required_artifacts: official no-records/nonresponsive reply, route, date, scope searched, custodian, appeal/follow-up option if stated
automatic_rejection: informal silence; no custodian/date; no request scope
allowed_credit: evidence of acquisition state and follow-up need only

required_artifacts: raw notes, handouts, lawful audio/transcript if available, speaker/role list, question/answer log, ANS demonstration statements
automatic_rejection: memory summary only; no timestamp; no source/capture method; no raw artifact
allowed_credit: candidate capture record for follow-up and official-record request
forbidden_credit: preliminary finding accepted as final readiness conclusion
